name: library_share
description: Replaces the full share list (team/projects/individuals/groups) of a library asset you can manage (`manage: true` in `library_list`, which includes team-managed assets you do not own) by numeric `id`. Types (as library_list emits): character/style/product/locations (references), color.

access.description: Share targets. Empty array shares with no one.

ids.description: Target ids (user/project/group). Required for project|individual|group; omit for team.

type.description: team = whole team (no ids). project|individual|group require ids.
